title: Suno · Pharaoh Piledriver [pharaoh_piledriver] · v3 · 52 Karten · ein Track
text:
[Spoken Word]

Wrestle like an Egyptian Mummy Master! Pharaoh Piledriver: Atum, Ra and Set.

Atum, Autogenesis: new rule from thin air; ultimate freelancer, no union dues.

Remember Nun, Reset Board: return to void; infinite dark water, unscripted pre-show.

Shu, Wall of Wind: blocks flying attacks, separates tag teams; holding kids apart.

Tefnut, Corrosive Spit: Equipment destroyed; born from a god's loogie.

You know Geb, Earthquake Laughter: shake table; laugh destroys cities, goose on head.

Nut, Star Fall: tokens drop; eats sun every night, heartburn central.

Ra, Executive Order: change turn order; sent lion to eat humanity, they stopped clapping.

What if Khepri, Resurrection Roll, retrieves card? Moves sun like ball of poop. It's a living.

Osiris, Undying Popularity: cannot be eliminated; boxed, drowned, chopped up, still biggest pop.

Isis, Gather the Pieces: reassemble destroyed card; conned sun god for his password.

Anyway, Set, Sandstorm Sabotage: blind opponent; killed brother over chair shot.

Horus, Vengeance Strike: double damage against Heel cards; fed uncle salad, secret ingredient.

Anubis, Weighing Scale: guess card value, if correct, eliminate it; heavy heart, no club.

No wait, Ma'at, Balance Check: equal stats; feather ruins afterlife, no cheating.

Ammit, Soul Crunch: permanently remove card; hearts of sinners, zero calorie diet.

Thoth, Wiki-Edit: change Lore; Inventor of writing, knows cheat codes.

Before we continue, Sekhmet, Rage Virus: attack every card including own; stopped by red beer.

Bastet, Claws & Cuddles: heal or scratch; don't touch belly.

Montu, Trample: ignore defense; Pharaoh's desire to hit things very hard.

Not a metaphor: Shezmu, The Squeeze: defeated cards into Perfume; skulls like grapes.

Sobek, Ambush Drag: pull opponent's card into River; loves robbery, eats tourists.

Tawaret, Mama Bear Smash: threatened Child, stats triple; hippos kill more people.

The thing about Khnum, Clay Clone: duplicate any card; babies out of river mud, original 3D printer.

Hapi, High Water: flood board; silt, life, wet socks.

Bes, Distraction Dance: cannot attack for laughing; ugly and loud, true hero.

Everyone agrees: Medjed, Laser Eyes: shoot beams from eyes; unseen Smiter.

Babi, Aggression: attack immediately, ask questions never; eats entrails. Gross.

Serket, Venom Heal: poison enemies or cure allies; misunderstood scorpions.

Have you heard of The Solar Barque, Night Travel? Skip opponent's turn; millions of years, zero maintenance.

The Scales of Justice, Judgment: lower stat eliminated; hippo eats you if tilted.

The Crook & Flail, Command: control opponent's card; shepherd people, beat grain.

Let me tell you about The Eye of Ra, Solar Flare: damage all Chaos cards; ancient remote-controlled drone strike.

Seshat, Blueprint: look at top cards; notches lifespan on stick, invented math.

Ptah, Spoken Reality: name card, opponent discards; thought world into existence.

This one has a rule: Imhotep, Polymath: use Manager power; mortal built pyramid, promoted to God.

Neith, Fate Weave: rearrange hand; wove universe, do not ask her to knit.

Apep, System Crash: end game, nobody wins unless Ra in play; pray against him.

Nobody warned us about The Akhekh, Desert Terror: Fear status; visual non-sequitur scares tourists.

Seven Scorpions, Swarm: 7 small attacks; bodyguards, they stung rich lady's son.

The Red Cloud, Blindness: accuracy zero; angry breath of Set, red is color of bad things.

The deck insists on Nekhbet, White Crown: defense with Wadjet; vultures good mothers.

Wadjet, Red Crown: attack with Nekhbet; fire-spitting snake, forehead protection.

Shai, The Script: decide dice outcome before rolling; can't fight booking committee.

Which brings us to Renenutet, Harvest Gold: resources each turn; snakes and milk.

The Duat, Graveyard cards attack; Underworld snakes, 12 gates to leave.

Meanwhile elsewhere, The Field of Reeds, heal all damage at end of turn; Aaru, just like Earth but no taxes.

Heliopolis, Solar gods get Stats; Ennead board meetings.

Do you know The Primeval Mound, High Ground? First solid ground; everything starts here.

The Lettuce Incident, Public Humiliation: opponent loses Cool points; Set ate salad with Horus's dressing. Awkward.

The Red Beer Trick, Forced Sleep: strongest attacker removed; thought blood, dyed beer.

Welcome to The Missing Piece, Prosthetic Power: replace lost limb with gold; fish ate the 14th.

The Extra 5 Days, Overtime: extra turn; Thoth won 5 extra days gambling.

Stay Fluffy!
